title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Vision Foundation Models for Active and Passive Seismic Data Denoising
abstract: arXiv:2605.10953v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The demand for high-resolution subsurface imaging and continuous Earth monitoring has driven rapid growth in active and passive seismic data from dense geophone deployments, distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) arrays, and large-scale 2D and 3D surveys. This expansion makes complex noise suppression increasingly challenging, especially when signal fidelity must be preserved. Conventional supervised deep learning methods are often task-specific, require large paired datasets, and can suffer from domain shift under new acquisition conditions. Foundation models offer a promising alternative, but pre-training seismic foundation models from scratch requires massive domain-specific data and substantial computation. We propose an efficient framework that repurposes general-purpose Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) for geophysical tasks through Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning. translated_title: 面向主动与被动地震数据去噪的预训练视觉基础模型参数高效适配方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.10953v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：对高分辨率地下成像和连续地球监测的需求，推动了来自密集检波器部署、分布式声学传感（DAS）阵列以及大规模二维和三维勘探的主动与被动地震数据的快速增长。这种数据规模的扩张使得复杂噪声压制变得愈发具有挑战性，尤其是在必须保持信号保真度的情况下。传统的监督深度学习方法通常具有任务专一性，需要大量成对数据集，并且在新的采集条件下可能出现域偏移问题。基础模型提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但从头预训练地震基础模型需要海量领域特定数据和大量计算资源。我们提出了一个高效的框架，通过参数高效微调将通用视觉基础模型（VFMs）重新用于地球物理任务。该架构使用预训练的VFM，即DINOv3编码器，对其进行适配……
tldr: 该论文提出一种参数高效微调框架，通过适配预训练视觉基础模型DINOv3来实现主动与被动地震数据的去噪，无需海量领域数据即可在保持信号保真度的同时压制复杂噪声。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework that adapts the pre-trained Vision Foundation Model DINOv3 for denoising active and passive seismic data, achieving complex noise suppression with preserved signal fidelity without requiring massive domain-specific data.
